display_name: Met 55.61.58 Openwork Strap Hinge Pre-Geometry Dossier
intent: Replace the generic sine-ribbon reading of the accepted GH-018 baseline with a reference-controlled construction grammar, prove the saved geometry under neutral clay, and keep material work blocked until the form is visually judged.

paired_photo_measurement.reason_for_range: The additional photograph is not an orthographic survey and contains blur, perspective, and two sibling objects.

scale_contract.hard_rule: The catalogued 0.406 m length belongs to the complete hinged object and must never again be assigned to the moving leaf alone.

primary_hypothesis.value: one connected openwork strap or plate whose apertures leave a continuous structural web
evidence: The paired photograph shows every motif connected to the side rails and adjacent cell junctions in one plane.
The central and flank leaf shapes are readable as negative apertures bounded by remaining iron.
The sibling hinge in the same photograph repeats the same connected topology with local deformation.

rejected_hypotheses.value: two independent sinusoidal ribbons woven over and under one another
rejected_hypotheses.reason: The paired photograph shows a five-bay pierced grammar with a central spine, flank apertures, and junction apertures rather than ten alternating lens openings.
The broad lit faces and edge lines read as flat wrought stock with face beveling.
The complete-object photograph shows alternating short knuckle barrels across the hinge width.

rejected_hypotheses.value: the pointed tail terminal is the hinge eye
rejected_hypotheses.reason: The additional image locates the segmented pivot at the opposite end and shows the pierced pointed terminal beyond the tail pad.

construction_read.manufacturing_method_rule: The geometry may reproduce the visible connected openwork but must not claim whether it was slit, punched, chiseled, fire-welded, or assembled until a technical source or side examination establishes that method.

fixed_leaf.read: short plain tapered plate with two attachment holes

pivot.read: alternating short knuckle barrels around a separate pintle

pintle.read: separate straight pin occupying the common bore without merging into either leaf
pintle.rule: Keep the pin within the catalogued cross-stock envelope; do not invent a decorative cap until a side view proves one.

moving_leaf.terminal: pierced pointed diamond between two rail extensions

fasteners.rule: Fastener heads are separate reusable components. Holes and local bearing seats belong to the leaf.
do_not_bake: black discs standing in for holes

symmetry.nominal: bilateral across the longitudinal centerline and repeated by cell translation
symmetry.reference_truth: the two museum siblings and individual cells contain bounded asymmetry
symmetry.implementation_rule: Build the exact nominal grammar first. Introduce only named, bounded control-point offsets after the nominal clay proof passes.

canonical_quarter.coordinate_meaning: u runs from pointed tip to longitudinal belly; v runs from symmetry axis to the aperture edge
canonical_quarter.authorship_rule: The point departure, shoulder acceleration, belly position, and tangent at the belly are editable authored decisions. They are not reconstructed from a sine wave.

S2_flank_leaf_aperture.role: paired curved apertures inside the outer leaf cage

S3_junction_petal_aperture.role: four diagonal apertures separating adjacent cell tips

S4_rail_lune_aperture.role: small side openings that maintain a quiet gap to each structural rail

S5_terminal_diamond.role: pointed tail terminal with a separate true circular bore

quarter_shape_library.hard_rule: Every repeated aperture must resolve to the canonical quarter curve plus named transforms. No per-cell freehand replacement and no generic random curve generator are allowed.

full_cell.silhouette_read: a pointed botanical leaf or eye with three subordinate apertures, not one empty sinusoidal lens

inter_cell_junction.construction_rule: The junction must be materially wider than the adjacent branch throats and may not collapse into a mathematical line crossing.

end_transitions.hinge_side: upper half-cell branches emerge from the reinforced pivot pad without a detached ribbon end
end_transitions.tail_side: lower half-cell branches enter the reinforced tail pad before the pierced terminal
end_transitions.repetition_rule: Neither end is produced by cropping a middle cell. Each owns an authored transition.

pattern_web.line_work_rule: The bevel shoulder and aperture lip are explicit continuous crease loops. Their spacing narrows through the belly and opens at load-bearing nodes, so the leaf is drawn by geometry under plain light.

side_rail.rule: Rails remain quieter, broader, and flatter than the leaf web. They do not receive the leaf crown profile.

junction_node.rule: A junction may widen and flatten, but it must not look like two bars physically passing through each other.

depth_unknowns.rear_face: keep planar in the first clay proof
depth_unknowns.front_face: use only the bounded relief ratios above
depth_unknowns.reason: No side or raking-light measurement proves alternating over-under depth.

hard_invalidations.finding: The full 0.406 m catalogue length was scaled to 4.06 m and assigned to the moving leaf alone.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Scale the complete two-leaf assembly to the catalogued envelope, then derive the moving leaf as an image-bounded fraction.

hard_invalidations.finding: Two sine paths generate approximately ten simple lens openings.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Construct five full botanical cells with central, flank, junction, and rail apertures.

hard_invalidations.finding: A cosine depth lane alternates the ribbons over and under.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Use one connected coplanar web with bounded face relief; keep woven crossings disabled.

hard_invalidations.finding: Each ribbon has one width, one thickness, and one bevel for its complete path.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Evaluate width, bevel land, bevel rise, crown, and flat-land fraction at named root, throat, shoulder, belly, return, and tip stations.

hard_invalidations.finding: One full rolled eye substitutes for the alternating knuckle schedule visible in the complete-object photograph.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Author short alternating knuckle barrels and a separate pintle interface across the hinge width.

hard_invalidations.finding: The tail and eye anatomy were inferred from the installed crop without consulting the complete-object image.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Keep the pointed pierced diamond at the tail and locate the segmented pivot at the opposite end.

hard_invalidations.finding: Two generic three-hole rectangular pads replace two distinct end transitions.
hard_invalidations.required_correction: Author pivot-pad, tail-pad, first half-cell, last half-cell, rail termination, and terminal as separate semantic zones.

retainable_contracts: no live construction modifiers in the final runtime output
front, reverse, three-quarter, pivot macro, and mounted proof views

implementation_contract.next_script_gate: The saved geometry reopened and passed topology, scale, hole, ownership, and semantic-lane inspection. The user then authorized the five-view neutral-clay geometry proof; forged-iron material remains blocked until those views are judged.

proof_render_contract.authorization: User said gogo after the five-view neutral-clay proof scope was stated.

view_intent.reference_front: Orthographic front view at the catalogued complete-object envelope for silhouette, rail continuity, five-cell rhythm, and negative-space comparison.
view_intent.oblique_depth: Three-quarter front view for stock thickness, crown, bevel shoulder, aperture lip, and terminal depth.
view_intent.cell_macro: Orthographic front crop centred on the middle cell for central lancet, flank leaves, junction petals, rail lunes, web thickness, and continuous crease loops.
view_intent.pivot_macro: Three-quarter pivot crop for all five knuckles, open seams, alternating ownership, bearing gap, and physical root overlap.
view_intent.rear_construction: Orthographic reverse view for planar rear stock, genuine through-holes, aperture walls, and absence of front-relief fakery.

presentation_rules: Use only the frozen runtime meshes from the geometry blend.
Do not apply transforms, modifiers, remeshing, subdivision, displacement, smoothing geometry, or corrective edits in the proof script.
Use one constant neutral clay on every runtime mesh.
Use a quiet neutral backdrop and three broad area lights.
Record exact camera, light, resolution, source, output, and geometry-hash evidence in a manifest.
Do not attach the forged-iron shader, damage, roughness breakup, rust, texture images, or procedural surface nodes.

planned_pipeline: Create the canonical Q0 cubic Bezier quarter in normalized cell space.
Generate the five named closed aperture profiles only through declared mirror, scale, shear, rotation, clip, and translation transforms.
Lay out five full cells, four inter-cell junctions, and two authored end transitions inside the measured moving-leaf envelope.
Solve the moving leaf as one connected 2D plate boundary with true aperture loops.
Create separate outer bevel-shoulder and inner aperture-lip loops so bevel width is geometry, not a global modifier guess.
Assign front-face elevation from the named section stations while keeping the first rear face planar.
Extrude true thickness, create aperture walls, and preserve explicit crease loops for the leaf line work.
Build alternating knuckle segments and the fixed leaf as separate components around one pivot datum.
Apply all construction transforms and validate the saved runtime meshes with no live modifiers.
Produce clay proofs before attaching forged-iron material.
prohibited_shortcuts: sine or wave textures used as geometry
roughness used to hide weak form

reference_overlay: five full cells align to the paired-image pattern field
central, flank, junction, and rail negative spaces remain individually legible
pivot and tail are on the correct ends
complete assembly, not only the moving leaf, fits the catalogued 4.06 m giant envelope
clay_geometry: leaf read survives neutral front light without material contrast
bevel shoulder and aperture lip create continuous sharp line work
root, throat, shoulder, belly, return, and tip have visibly different but restrained sections
no mathematical line crossing or accidental fused intersection remains
rear face, aperture walls, and segmented knuckles are visible in dedicated proofs
runtime: separate moving leaf, fixed leaf, pintle, and fastener ownership
